SELECT /*selectBuyerMpRqCatalogRegYnPopList*/ Z.BUYER_ITEM_NO, Z.DESCRIPTION, Z.SPECIFICATION, Z.UNIT_MEASURE, Z.MAKER_NAME, Z.CATEG_PATH, Z.IMGFILE_DIR, Z.IMGFILE_NAME, Z.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Z.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, Z.UNIT_PRICE, Z.TARGET_PRICE, Z.BUY_GREEN_ITEM_NM FROM ( SELECT Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CASE Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN '[단종]' WHEN 'S' THEN '[견적(미승인)]' WHEN 'G' THEN '[견적(가합의)]' ELSE decode(cqdt_count,0,'[미계약]',null) END||Y.DESCRIPTION as DESCRIPTION, Y.SPECIFICATION, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, Y.MAKER_NAME, Y.CATEG_PATH, Y.IMGFILE_DIR, Y.IMGFILE_NAME, Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Y.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, Y.UNIT_PRICE, Y.TARGET_PRICE, Y.BUY_GREEN_ITEM_NM FROM ( SELECT BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, BYIT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, BYIT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, BYCA.CATEG_PATH AS CATEG_PATH, BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR AS IMGFILE_DIR, BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME AS IMGFILE_NAME, BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, BYIT.OVER_SHORT_FLAG AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, BYIT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, (select count(*) from icomcqdt where status <> 'D' and buyer = byit.buyer and buyer_item_no = byit.buyer_item_no and below_comorg_code = #{com_code}) as cqdt_count , CQDT.TARGET_PRICE, BYIT.BUY_GREEN_ITEM_NM FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT, ICOMBYCA BYCA , ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE BYIT.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE =#{com_code}) AND BYIT.BUYER = BYCA.COM_CODE AND BYIT.CATEGORY_NO = BYCA.STD_CATEG_ID AND BYIT.BUYER = CQDT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.STATUS != 'D'
AND UPPER(BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_buyer_item_no})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_description})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYIT.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_specification})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYIT.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_maker_name})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYCA.CATEG_PATH) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_categ_name})||'%'
ORDER BY BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC,SPECIFICATION,BYIT.MAKER_NAME )Y ) Z

SELECT /*selectBuyerMpRqCatalogRegYnPopList_v2*/ Z.BUYER_ITEM_NO, Z.DESCRIPTION, Z.SPECIFICATION, Z.UNIT_MEASURE, Z.MAKER_NAME, Z.CATEG_PATH, Z.IMGFILE_DIR, Z.IMGFILE_NAME, Z.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Z.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, Z.UNIT_PRICE, Z.TARGET_PRICE, Z.BUY_GREEN_ITEM_NM, Z.CATEG_NAME, Z.CATEG_ID, Z.MAKER_PART_NO, Z.ORIGIN_CODE, Z.ORIGIN_NAME
FROM ( SELECT Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CASE Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG WHEN 'Y' THEN '[단종]' WHEN 'S' THEN '[견적(미승인)]' WHEN 'G' THEN '[견적(가합의)]' ELSE decode(cqdt_count,0,'[미계약]',null) END||Y.DESCRIPTION as DESCRIPTION, Y.SPECIFICATION, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, Y.MAKER_NAME, Y.CATEG_PATH, Y.IMGFILE_DIR, Y.IMGFILE_NAME, Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Y.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, Y.UNIT_PRICE, Y.TARGET_PRICE, Y.BUY_GREEN_ITEM_NM, Y.CATEG_NAME, Y.CATEG_ID, Y.MAKER_PART_NO, Y.ORIGIN_CODE, Y.ORIGIN_NAME FROM ( SELECT BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, BYIT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, BYIT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, BYCA.CATEG_PATH AS CATEG_PATH, BYIT.IMGFILE_DIR AS IMGFILE_DIR, BYIT.IMGFILE_NAME AS IMGFILE_NAME, BYIT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, BYIT.OVER_SHORT_FLAG AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, BYIT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, (select count(*) from icomcqdt where status <> 'D' and buyer = byit.buyer and buyer_item_no = byit.buyer_item_no and below_comorg_code = #{com_code}) as cqdt_count , CQDT.TARGET_PRICE, BYIT.BUY_GREEN_ITEM_NM, BYCA.CATEG_NAME AS CATEG_NAME, BYCA.STD_CATEG_ID AS CATEG_ID, BYIT.MAKER_PART_NO AS MAKER_PART_NO, BYIT.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = BYIT.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT, ICOMBYCA BYCA , ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE BYIT.BUYER = (SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE =#{com_code}) AND BYIT.BUYER = BYCA.COM_CODE AND BYIT.CATEGORY_NO = BYCA.STD_CATEG_ID AND BYIT.BUYER = CQDT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.STATUS != 'D' AND CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = #{com_code}
AND UPPER(BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_buyer_item_no})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_description})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYIT.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_specification})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYIT.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_maker_name})||'%'
AND UPPER(BYCA.CATEG_PATH) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_categ_name})||'%'
ORDER BY BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC,SPECIFICATION,BYIT.MAKER_NAME )Y ) Z
